# vercel-gin-mcp

> A Go-based MCP (Model Context Protocol) server optimized for Vercel deployment, featuring web scraping and GitHub document download capabilities with concurrent goroutine pools and RAG functionality.

This server provides tools for fetching web content, downloading GitHub documentation, and performing recursive crawling with RAG search capabilities. It's designed for efficient concurrent processing using goroutine pools.

## Core Features

- [MCP Protocol Support](https://modelcontextprotocol.ai/) - Full compatibility with Model Context Protocol
- [Vercel Optimization](https://vercel.com/) - Optimized for serverless deployment
- [Concurrent Processing](./handler/mcp/concurrent/pool.go) - Goroutine pools for efficient resource management
- [Web Scraping](./handler/mcp/tools/scraper.go) - HTML to Markdown conversion using gocolly
- [GitHub Integration](./handler/mcp/tools/downhub.go) - Download documentation from GitHub repositories
- [RAG Search](./handler/mcp/tools/rag.go) - Recursive crawling with BM25-based search
- [Multi-site Crawling](./handler/mcp/tools/crawler.go) - Concurrent crawling of multiple websites

## API Endpoints

- [MCP Endpoint](./api/index.go) - Main MCP protocol endpoint at `/mcp`

## Tools Available

- [echo](./api/index.go) - Simple text echo functionality
- [add](./api/index.go) - Basic arithmetic operations
- [fetch](./api/index.go) - Single URL web scraping to Markdown
- [fetch_md](./api/index.go) - Fetch web content returning only Markdown
- [download_docs](./api/index.go) - Download GitHub repository documents
- [download_docs_md](./api/index.go) - Download GitHub docs as combined Markdown
- [rag_crawl](./api/index.go) - Recursive crawl with RAG search on single site
- [rag_crawl_multi](./api/index.go) - Concurrent crawling of multiple sites with RAG search

## Technical Details

- [Go Implementation](./go.mod) - Built with Go 1.24+
- [Dependencies](./go.mod) - Gin, gocolly, go-git, and other libraries
- [Concurrent Utilities](./handler/mcp/utils/math.go) - Helper functions for concurrent operations
